[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The network-tier resource is configured for this project but does not wait for the Compute API activation resource. When Compute API is included in the module's services, Terraform could attempt this operation before that API is enabled.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Compute default network tier resource calls the Compute API, but it has no ordering dependency on project service activation. If compute.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, activation should complete before this operation.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The Shared VPC service-project association performs a Compute operation on this project but only waits for the VPC Service Controls resources. It should also wait for project service activation so the Compute API is enabled before the association is created.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
Attaching this project as a Shared VPC service project requires the Compute API, but the resource does not wait for this module's project service activation to complete.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
Log-based metrics require the Cloud Logging API, but this resource does not wait for project service activation. It can race logging.googleapis.com enablement when that service is managed here.

----------------------------------------
